An asset fetched from an observed CDN prefix but not directly referenced remains a missing-reference finding.

Shopify CDN JPEG optimisation can change byte hashes. Artwork is checked against the packaged source for equal decoded dimensions and RGB root-mean-square error <= 8 on the 0–255 scale; exact byte hashes are retained separately and are not required for CDN copies.
The public JavaScript response is CDN-minified. Its explicitly referenced public source map contains the exact approved source SHA-256; both delivered and source hashes are recorded.
